Make your best-guess edit in the most likely place with your next call, run one verification, and submit by call 11 — no later than 4 minutes in. Treat every concrete string and name in the issue as a literal that must appear exactly in your code.

- Still unlocated at the call-5 checkpoint: best-guess edit, one verification, submit by call 11. Finishing a hopeless task early is correct behaviour, not a failure.
